sources.title: LLM Agent-Based Design of RISC-V CPUs with FPGA-in-the-Loop Evaluation
sources.snippet: Long-run RTL simulation of CPU candidates can take hours, while short diagnostic runs may miss performance degradation that emerges later in execution. This evaluation cost can delay design decisions in LLM-agent-based CPU development. We present a development environment in which LLM agents implement CPU candidates on an FPGA and use on-board performance measurements to guide design decisions.
